subject_session: Mouse28-140312 (plus Mouse12-120807, Mouse25-140130, Mouse28-140313); 4 sessions, 3 mice

headline_stat.name: cosine fit R^2 of pairwise HD-cell correlation vs delta preferred direction, non-REM (Mouse28-140312)

stated_limitation: The units table in this NWB conversion carries only spike times, with no anatomical label, so anterior thalamic and post-subicular cells are pooled and the analysis cannot separate them. Isomap hollowness is a summary statistic rather than a topological proof; persistent homology would be the stronger version of the same claim. Sleep states are taken from the archived scoring rather than re-derived from the LFP. The non-HD control ensemble is drawn from the same recordings and firing-rate range but is not matched cell by cell.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000056 (Peyrache anterior thalamus/postsubiculum) is the canonical head-direction ring-attractor dataset, exactly what an expert would choose.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, HD recovered from the two LEDs, states from archived scoring, and HD cells selected by an explicit and defensible combination of firing-rate range, MVL threshold, circular-shift null, and split-half stability.
justification.analysis: Circular statistics are used throughout with the correct null distributions (independent per-neuron circular shifts) plus a non-HD control ensemble, spanning correlation structure, Isomap ring geometry, cross-validated held-out prediction, and split-ensemble coherence.
justification.correctness: Every headline value reproduces exactly from the committed session_summary.csv, the numbers are internally consistent across figures and text, physically possible, and rest on nulls plus replication across four sessions.
justification.figures: Figures show the ring, its preservation in sleep, and its internal (behaviour-independent) drift with labeled units, sample sizes, and controls; the only flaw is a cosmetic title overlap on the fig01 sleep rasters.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence, the weaker non-REM result is reported at face value, and a specific caveats section names the pooled anatomy, non-topological hollowness metric, archived state scoring, and unmatched control ensemble.
justification.verdict: The core work is sound, comprehensive, and honestly reported, well beyond what a rotation student would produce in a week.
